faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Ocicat?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 6-15 lb (2.7-7 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a senior Ocicat?
faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights Dental disease; Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) talks; Obesity. Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.

faqs.question: How often should I weigh my Ocicat at this stage?
faqs.answer: At least every 30 days for a senior Ocicat, sooner if appetite, thirst, or mobility changes.
